question: Which BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB and XRP long exposures have a verifiable direct USDC spot implementation on Hyperliquid mainnet, and what are the current spot-versus-perp order-book capacity, spread, fee and basis diagnostics at fixed notionals?
fixed_info_requests: l2Book for every candidate spot pair and target perp

book_assumption.marketable_vwap: consume returned asks for buys and bids for sells in price order
book_assumption.reference_mid: best bid/ask midpoint when both sides exist; otherwise official allMids/asset context fallback is reported but not used to manufacture a fill
book_assumption.unfilled_notional: reported explicitly; no extrapolation beyond returned levels
book_assumption.slippage_bps: signed absolute execution deterioration relative to best-book midpoint

deterministic_candidate_discovery.direct_quote_token: USDC token index from spot metadata
deterministic_candidate_discovery.additional_candidate: base-token name or fullName contains the target ticker as a standalone case-insensitive token
deterministic_candidate_discovery.official_ui_remap_exception: BTC target may classify UBTC/USDC as explicit_ui_remap because official Hyperliquid API documentation states that UI BTC/USDC maps to UBTC/USDC on mainnet HyperCore
deterministic_candidate_discovery.all_other_remapped_or_wrapped_candidates: candidate_only unless exact token metadata independently establishes economic identity; no automatic routing approval

classification.verified_exact: base token name exactly equals target, quote is USDC, pair and token are canonical
classification.verified_official_ui_remap: only the preregistered official BTC-to-UBTC mapping, with metadata retained
classification.candidate_canonical: candidate pair is canonical but economic identity is not established by exact name or official remap
classification.candidate_wrapped_or_bridged: noncanonical pair/token or non-null EVM contract

fixed_fee_scenarios.fee_purpose: current conservative execution-cost diagnostic only, not historical PNL

required_outputs: complete direct-USDC spot pair inventory for deterministic target candidates
spot universe index, order asset ID 10000+index, pair name and API coin
base/quote token indices, names, szDecimals, weiDecimals, tokenId, isCanonical, evmContract and fullName
tokenDetails response for each discovered candidate
perp universe index, order asset ID, szDecimals, maxLeverage, delisted/isolation metadata
spot and perp asset contexts including mid/mark/oracle/funding/open interest/day volume when available
best bid, best ask, spread and returned depth
buy/sell VWAP, filled notional, unfilled notional, levels used and slippage for all fixed notionals
base-tier taker and maker fee amounts for every fixed notional
spot-perp midpoint/mark basis where a candidate exists
classification and exact reason by target
raw API snapshots and machine-readable summary

success_gate.metadata: spot and perp metadata parse successfully and all target perps are identified or explicitly absent
success_gate.books: l2Book responses parse for every discovered candidate and target perp, including explicit empty books
success_gate.classification: no token is called a verified spot substitute solely because its name resembles the target

prohibited: no spot-first routing promotion from one snapshot
no assumption that a U- or W-prefixed token is economically equivalent except the documented BTC-to-UBTC UI remap
no extrapolation beyond twenty returned book levels
no historical fee or liquidity inference from the current snapshot
no post-result alias, notional, fee or classification change under this audit ID
next_experiment_rule: A ROUTER-SHADOW experiment may be preregistered only for targets whose spot classification and executable-book evidence are explicit. Unverified or unavailable assets must remain perp-only or unavailable in the first router; external venues require a separate audit.
